notes: Said was asked («قال سئلت») by an unnamed asker; the saying is Ibn Umar's answer, so Ibn Umar is the last link as the one asked who answers
the vocative «يا أبا عبد الرحمن» addresses the same Ibn Umar and adds no link; «فقال ابن جبير» is Said named in Ibn Umar's words, not a new link
«فلان بن فلان» inside the saying is not a transmitter
